blocking_issues.location: sections on Iberian integration, Sines, Atlantic islands, regional differences and Atlantic security
blocking_issues.issue: The country dossier meets the numerical chart/table/structural-visual floor, but geography and corridor exposure are central mechanisms and there is no geographic map. The text depends materially on Iberian interconnection, Sines logistics, Azores/Madeira, regional economic concentration and Atlantic security routes. Under RESEARCH-VISUALS.md and COUNTRY-CONTEXT.md, a map is required by editorial judgment when spatial concentration, corridor exposure, regional transmission or external relationships are central and a map is clearer than prose.
blocking_issues.evidence: EN contains multiple charts, a flow, a mindmap and a contradiction table, but no map fence across the reviewed source; the same geographic mechanisms are material to the thesis.

required_fixes: Add an evidence-bearing deterministic map in both EN and PT-BR with semantic parity. It should encode the material geography actually defended in the report, such as Portugal-Spain electricity/gas integration, Pyrenees continental interconnection constraint, Sines Atlantic logistics/energy node, and Azores/Madeira Atlantic exposure. Do not invent coordinates or quantitative flows not supported by cited evidence.

Keep all existing quantitative claims, dates and causal qualifications unchanged unless separately revalidated; the spot checks of Q2 2026 house-price growth and the 29 September 2026 final PRR payment request were consistent with current Eurostat and Portuguese government primary sources.
After adding the map, re-run EN/PT-BR visual-parity and publication-readiness checks and return the same ID with changed source SHAs.
evidence: Eurostat release of 1 October 2026 confirms Portugal house prices +16.5% year on year in Q2 2026, with Q4 2025 +18.9% and Q1 2026 +17.8%.
Portuguese Government release of 29 September 2026 confirms the 10th and final PRR payment request of EUR 4.672 billion net of advances and total allocation of EUR 21.905 billion.

COUNTRY-CONTEXT.md requires at least one table, one chart, one structural visual and at least four useful visuals, and directs use of a map when spatial concentration, trade corridors, energy dependence, regional inequality or external relationships are central.

RESEARCH-VISUALS.md makes visual readiness blocking and requires a map by editorial judgment when spatial distribution, corridor exposure, regional transmission or country-to-country dependence is central and a map is clearer than prose.
